description: Answers a question about a YouTube video using its frames and audio, with timestamps as evidence. Ask specific questions (what is on the slide at 4:10, which settings are clicked, what numbers are shown). Without a question it returns a detailed description.

detail.description: "low" sends frames at low resolution. It saves tokens only on Gemini 2.5 models; Gemini 3 and newer treat it like the default.

end.description: Analyze up to this point. Same formats as `start`.

question.description: The question. Omit it to get a detailed description of the video.

response_language.description: Language of the answer, e.g. "Russian". By default the language of the question, otherwise English.

start.description: Analyze from this point on. Seconds (90), MM:SS (1:30) or H:MM:SS (1:02:03).

youtube_url.description: YouTube video link (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live or embed) or the 11-character video ID.

name: ask_about_youtube_video
title: Ask about a YouTube video
